            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    lg=[j for j,v in enumerate(t[bot]) if v!=bg]
    for j in range(max(lg)+1,w): out[bot][j]=1

import collections
def g(inp,fill=1):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r in inp for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]

        if lg:

import collections
def g(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r in inp for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    for i in range(h-1):
        fg=[j for j,v in enumerate(inp[i]) if v!=bg]
        if len(fg)>=4:
            for x in range(max(fg)+1,w): out[i][x]=1
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, g(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
s=g(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(s))

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
import collections
def g(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r in inp for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    # group consecutive rows with fg; extend bottom row of each group
    i=0
    while i<h:
        j=i
        while j<h and any(inp[j][c]!=bg for c in range(w)): j+=1
        bot=j-1
        if i<bot:  # multi-row object: only bottom row extended
            run=[c for c in range(w) if inp[bot][c]!=bg]
            for x in range(max(run)+1,w): out[bot][x]=1
        i=j
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(k, g(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(g(G['Test input'])))

# Implement unified rule: bg = most common color; for each row containing a marker cell left of its rightmost bg-run, fill that bg-run with 1. Verify all demos.
from collections import Counter
def f(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r_ in grid for x in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r_ in range(h):
        cells=[c for c,x in enumerate(grid[r_]) if x==bg]
        if not cells: continue
        end=max(cells)
        s=end
        while s>0 and grid[r_][s-1]==bg: s-=1
        # is there any marker before this run?
        if any(grid[r_][c]!=bg for c in range(s)):
            for c in range(s,end+1): out[r_][c]=1
    return out
